65102.meaning1: grief, wailing, pain, suffering and trouble

65102.construction:

sokaparidevadukkhadomanassūpāyāsa + ā
65102.compound: dvanda (soka ca parideva ca dukkha ca domanassa ca upāyāsa ca)
65102.commentary: (DNa) uppajjanti soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā. tattha antonijjhāyanalakkhaṇo soko, tannissitalālappanalakkhaṇo paridevo, kāyappaṭipīḷanalakkhaṇaṃ dukkhaṃ, manovighātalakkhaṇaṃ domanassaṃ, visādalakkhaṇo upāyāso, vivicc'eva kāmehītiādīnamattho visuddhimagge vutto.

examples.text: so taṃ itthiṃ passeyya aññena purisena saddhiṃ santiṭṭhantiṃ sallapantiṃ sañjagghantiṃ saṃhasantiṃ. taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu tassa purisassa amuṃ itthiṃ disvā aññena purisena saddhiṃ santiṭṭhantiṃ sallapantiṃ sañjagghantiṃ saṃhasantiṃ uppajjeyyuṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'ūpāyāsā'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

65103.commentary: (DHPa) tiṇṇasokapariddave'ti atikkantasokapariddave, ime dve atikkante'ti attho. etehi pūj'ārahattaṃ dassitaṃ. (SNPa) sokapariddavañ'cā'ti sokañ'ca paridevañ'ca.

examples.text: pūj'ārahe pūjayato, buddhe yadi va sāvake, papañcasamatikkante, tiṇṇasokapariddave.
yaṃ taṃ apucchimha akittayī no, aññaṃ taṃ pucchāma tadiṅgha brūhi, kathaṃ nu dhīrā vitaranti oghaṃ, jātiṃ jaraṃ sokapariddavañ'ca, taṃ me muni sādhu viyākarohi, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo.

65104.meaning1: afflicted with sorrow; overcome with sadness; overwhelmed with grief
65104.commentary: (SNa) sokaparetassā'ti sokena phuṭṭhassa. (THIa) yaṃ me sokaparetāyā'ti yasmā sokena abhibhūtāya

examples.text: abbahī vata me sallaṃ, duddasaṃ hadayassitaṃ, yaṃ me sokaparetāya, dhītusokaṃ byapānudi.
tassa sokaparetassa, vīṇā kacchā abhassatha, tato so dummano yakkho, tatth'ev'antaradhāyathā'ti.

65105.meaning1: sorrow, crying and stinginess; grief, lamentation and selfishness
65105.compound: dvanda (soka ca parideva ca macchara ca)
65105.commentary: (NIDD1) soko'ti ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa sīlabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa diṭṭhibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa aññatar'aññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa aññatar'aññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa soko socanā socitattaṃ antosoko antoparisoko antodāho antoparidāho cetaso parijjhāyanā domanassaṃ sokasallaṃ. paridevo'ti ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa… diṭṭhibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa aññatar'aññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa aññatar'aññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa ādevo paridevo ādevanā paridevanā ādevitattaṃ paridevitattaṃ vācā palāpo vippalāpo lālappo lālappāyanā lālappāyitattaṃ. macchariyan'ti pañca macchariyāni, āvāsamacchariyaṃ, kulamacchariyaṃ, lābhamacchariyaṃ, vaṇṇamacchariyaṃ, dhammamacchariyaṃ.

examples.text: sokapparidevamaccharaṃ, na jahanti giddhā mamāyite, tasmā munayo pariggahaṃ, hitvā acariṃsu khemadassino.

65106.grammar: ind, adv, comp, loc sg of sokamajjha
65106.meaning1: in the midst of sorrow; amidst sadness
65106.commentary: (SNa) sokamajjhe'ti sokavatthūnaṃ sok'ānugatānaṃ vā sattānaṃ majjhagato na socati bandhulamallasenāpatissa upāsikā viya, pañcannaṃ corasatānaṃ majjhe dhammasenāpatissa saddhivihāriko saṃkiccasāmaṇero viya ca.

examples.text: sabbhi'r'eva samāsetha, sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ, sataṃ saddhammam'aññāya, sokamajjhe na socatī'ti.

65107.meaning1: who has gone beyond grief; who has transcended sorrow

examples.text: anantadassī bhagavā'ham'asmi, jātijaraṃ sokam'upātivatto, kiṃ me purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, ācikkha me taṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññā'ti.

65108.meaning1: pig farmer; boar hunter; pork butcher; pig dealer
65108.commentary: (APAa) sūkariko'ti sūkaramaṃsaṃ vikkiṇitvā jīvikaṃ kappento. (MNt) sakuṇe hanatī'ti sākuṇiko, tathā sūkariko.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu tumhehi diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā, orabbhiko … sokariko … sākuṇiko … māgaviko mage vadhitvā vadhitvā vikkiṇamāno tena kammena tena ājīvena hatthiyāyī vā assayāyī vā rathayāyī vā yānayāyī vā bhogabhogī vā mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ ajjhāvasantoti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

examples.text: ussussati anāhāro, sokasallasamappito, atho'pi evaṃ cittassa, jhāne na ramatī mano.
cetaso parijjhāyanā domanassaṃ sokasallaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati soko.

65110.meaning1: (named) pulling out the arrow of grief; removing the dart of sorrow

examples.text: evaṃ vutte muṇḍo rājā āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ etadavoca, ko nāmo ayaṃ, bhante, dhammapariyāyo'ti? sokasallaharaṇo nāma ayaṃ, mahārāja, dhammapariyāyo'ti. taggha, bhante, sokasallaharaṇo!

65111.commentary: (VINa) sokajjhāyikā nāma māyākārā. (JAa) sokajjhāyikā'ti māyākārā, aññe'pi vā ye keci uppannasokaharaṇasamatthā sokajjhāyikā'ti vuccanti, socante jane attano vaṃsaghosaparam'parānaṃ nacce kate nissoke katvā sayāpakā'ti attho.

examples.text: yena yena subhikkhāni, sivāni abhayāni ca, tena puttaka gacchassu, mā sokāpahato bhavā'ti.

65190.meaning1: (all four) with neck as the fifth

examples.text: disvāna yena kummo kacchapo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā kummaṃ kacchapaṃ paccupaṭṭhito ahosi, yadā'yaṃ kummo kacchapo soṇḍipañcamānaṃ aṅgānaṃ aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgaṃ abhininnāmessati, tatth'eva naṃ gahetvā uddālitvā khādissāmī'ti.
itthiṃ soṇḍiṃ vikiraṇiṃ, purisaṃ vā'pi tādisaṃ, issariyasmiṃ ṭhāpeti, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.
attha hi udakasoṇḍīsu udakakiccaṃ katvā sītāya rukkhacchāyāya nisinnassa nānādisāsu khāyamānāsu sītena vātena vījiyamānassa cittaṃ ek'aggaṃ hoti.
najjāyo supatitthāyo, soṇṇavālukasanthatā, acchā savanti ambūni, macchagumbanisevitā.
evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, majjhe nadiyā soto vikkhitto visaṭo byādiṇṇo n'eva dūraṅ'gamo assa na sīghasoto na hārahārī.
savanti sabbadhi sotā, sotānaṃ kiṃ nivāraṇaṃ, sotānaṃ saṃvaraṃ brūhi, kena sotā pidhiyyare.
yañ'ca, bhikkhave, tassa dīpassa uttarante udakaṃ, yañ'ca dakkhiṇ'ante udakaṃ, ayaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā dve sotāni tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchanti.
bhikkhuno sotena saddaṃ sutvā uppajjati manāpaṃ, uppajjati amanāpaṃ, uppajjati manāp'āmanāpaṃ.
app'eva nām'āhaṃ imesaṃ cakkhuto vā otāraṃ labheyyaṃ, sotato vā otāraṃ labheyyaṃ, ghānato vā otāraṃ labheyyaṃ, jivhāto vā otāraṃ labheyyaṃ, kāyato vā otāraṃ labheyyaṃ, manato vā otāraṃ labheyyan'ti.
